psalm-25-1.verse: To You, O Lord, I lift up my soul.
psalm-25-1.prayer: Lord, I lift up my soul to You. Help me place my trust fully in Your hands and seek You above all else.

psalm-25-2.verse: O my God, in You I trust, Do not let me be ashamed; Do not let my enemies exult over me.
psalm-25-2.prayer: Father, I trust in You. Keep me from fear, shame, and discouragement, and strengthen my confidence in Your faithfulness.

psalm-25-3.verse: Indeed, none of those who wait for You will be ashamed; Those who deal treacherously without cause will be ashamed.
psalm-25-3.prayer: Lord, thank You that those who hope in You will not be disappointed. Help me patiently wait for Your timing and Your promises.

psalm-25-4.verse: Make me know Your ways, O Lord; Teach me Your paths.
psalm-25-4.prayer: Father, show me Your ways and teach me Your paths. Guide my decisions and direct my steps according to Your will.

psalm-25-5.verse: Lead me in Your truth and teach me, For You are the God of my salvation; For You I wait all the day.
psalm-25-5.prayer: Lord, lead me in Your truth and teach me. Help me remain humble and willing to follow wherever You lead.

psalm-25-6.verse: Remember, O Lord, Your compassion and Your lovingkindnesses, For they have been from of old.
psalm-25-6.prayer: Father, thank You for Your compassion and lovingkindness that have been present throughout every season of my life.

psalm-25-7.verse: Do not remember the sins of my youth or my transgressions; According to Your lovingkindness remember me, For Your goodness’ sake, O Lord.
psalm-25-7.prayer: Lord, forgive my sins and shortcomings. Help me walk in the freedom of Your mercy and grace.

psalm-25-8.verse: Good and upright is the Lord; Therefore He instructs sinners in the way.
psalm-25-8.prayer: Father, thank You that You are good and upright. Thank You for patiently teaching those who seek You.

psalm-25-9.verse: He leads the humble in justice, And He teaches the humble His way.
psalm-25-9.prayer: Lord, give me a humble heart that is willing to learn from You and follow Your instruction.

psalm-25-10.verse: All the paths of the Lord are lovingkindness and truth To those who keep His covenant and His testimonies.
psalm-25-10.prayer: Father, all Your ways are loving and faithful. Help me trust Your guidance even when I do not fully understand it.

psalm-25-11.verse: For Your name’s sake, O Lord, Pardon my iniquity, for it is great.
psalm-25-11.prayer: Lord, for the sake of Your name, forgive my sins and continue Your work of transformation in my life.

psalm-25-12.verse: Who is the man who fears the Lord? He will instruct him in the way he should choose.
psalm-25-12.prayer: Father, help me fear You with reverence and awe. Teach me the way I should go and establish my path.

psalm-25-13.verse: His soul will abide in prosperity, And his descendants will inherit the land.
psalm-25-13.prayer: Lord, thank You for the blessings that come from walking with You. Help me live faithfully and enjoy the peace You provide.

psalm-25-14.verse: The secret of the Lord is for those who fear Him, And He will make them know His covenant.
psalm-25-14.prayer: Father, thank You for revealing Yourself to those who seek You. Draw me into a deeper relationship with You each day.

psalm-25-15.verse: My eyes are continually toward the Lord, For He will pluck my feet out of the net.
psalm-25-15.prayer: Lord, keep my eyes fixed on You. Deliver me from distractions and help me focus on Your truth.

psalm-25-16.verse: Turn to me and be gracious to me, For I am lonely and afflicted.
psalm-25-16.prayer: Father, turn toward me with Your mercy and compassion when I feel lonely, burdened, or overwhelmed.

psalm-25-17.verse: The troubles of my heart are enlarged; Bring me out of my distresses.
psalm-25-17.prayer: Lord, bring relief to my troubles and grant me peace in the midst of every challenge.

psalm-25-18.verse: Look upon my affliction and my trouble, And forgive all my sins.
psalm-25-18.prayer: Father, see my struggles and forgive my sins. Thank You for Your grace that continually restores me.

psalm-25-19.verse: Look upon my enemies, for they are many, And they hate me with violent hatred.
psalm-25-19.prayer: Lord, protect me from those things that seek to harm my faith and draw me away from You.

psalm-25-20.verse: Guard my soul and deliver me; Do not let me be ashamed, for I take refuge in You.
psalm-25-20.prayer: Father, guard my soul and keep me secure in Your care. Help me continue trusting in You.

psalm-25-21.verse: Let integrity and uprightness preserve me, For I wait for You.
psalm-25-21.prayer: Lord, let integrity and uprightness guide my life as I wait upon You and depend on Your wisdom.

psalm-25-22.verse: Redeem Israel, O God, Out of all his troubles.
psalm-25-22.prayer: Father, bring deliverance and restoration to Your people. May Your grace and mercy be known throughout the world.

psalm-25-closing.verse:
Lord, thank You for Your guidance, mercy, and faithfulness. Teach me Your ways, lead me in Your truth, and help me trust You in every circumstance. Forgive my sins, strengthen my faith, and keep my eyes fixed upon You. May I walk humbly before You, experience the peace of Your presence, and follow You faithfully all the days of my life.

In Jesus’ name, Amen. 🙏🏻
